query_text: what is a good title for a poem I'm writing about a religious boy who has been sheltered from the outside world by his family, but one day he leaves his house and sees the reality of the world?

content.text:
Here are some title ideas that could fit that theme:

- **“Beyond the Garden Wall”**
- **“The First Sin of Seeing”**
- **“Outside Eden”**
- **“The World Beyond the Window”**
- **“When the Veil Fell”**
- **“A Boy at the Edge of Heaven”**
- **“The Day He Saw the World”**
- **“Unprayed Truths”**
- **“Leaving the Ark”**
- **“The Gospel of the Street”**
- **“Eyes Opened”**
- **“The World Was Not a Prayer”**
- **“After the Amen”**
- **“Saint of the Doorway”**
- **“The Garden Ends Here”**

My favorites for a poetic, layered feel would be **“Outside Eden”**, **“The First Sin of Seeing”**, or **“The World Was Not a Prayer.”**
